mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM tenant) AS tenants, (SELECT count(*) FROM user_account) AS users, (SELECT count(*) FROM workspace) AS workspaces, (SELECT count(*) FROM workspace_member) AS members, (SELECT count(*) FROM user_identity) AS identities
mapper.update: UPDATE sms_verification_challenge SET expires_at = #{expiry} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE user_account SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE user_identity SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: WITH session AS ( INSERT INTO optimization_session(id, tenant_id, workspace_id, created_by, title) VALUES(#{id}, #{tenant}, #{workspace}, #{user}, 'Synthetic SMS acceptance') RETURNING id ) INSERT INTO optimization_record(id, tenant_id, workspace_id, session_id, created_by, template_code, raw_prompt, optimized_prompt) SELECT #{id}, #{tenant}, #{workspace}, id, #{user}, 'GENERAL', 'synthetic input', 'synthetic result' FROM session
mapper.select: SELECT md5(coalesce(string_agg(row_to_json(r)::text, ',' ORDER BY id), '')) FROM optimization_record r
